lines: Maye played 66% of snaps over his last 3 games, down from 88% on the season, and averaged 20.7 pass attempts a game.
He averaged 14.6 PPR points over his last 3 games and has scored 21 total touchdowns this season.
NE has a bye in Wk 11, he is listed as out for the season, and the coach said he will likely not be available after the bye.
